caption: The drawing shows three views of a spoon, all rendered in shades of gray pencil on a beige, lightly textured background. The first spoon on the left is depicted from a top-down view, where the oval bowl and long, straight handle with a slightly rounded, wider end are visible. The middle view presents the spoon from its side, displaying the gentle curve of the handle and the depth of the bowl. The rightmost view shows another top-down perspective similar to the leftmost spoon, but the details may vary slightly in their depiction. Below the larger drawings, there is a small, faint rectangular diagram that provides a top-down schematic of the spoon with some reference letters and measurements. The entire composition is enclosed within a rectangular border in the center of the page, and the area outside the border is left mostly blank except for some tint along the edges.
title: Pewter Spoon
